text:
mia: quick alert 0 nodes in us-west-2 warmpool stuck 'joining' since 5m ago. allocator: "keystore: dial tcp 10.250.8.9:443: connect: i/o timeout"
devon: looks like new egress NAT policy denied 10.250.0.0/16 outbound. internal-keystore lives at 10.250.8.9.
pat: if nodes can't unwrap disk keys they never complete boot -> idle GPUs accumulate and bill. we need a fast, compliant fix.
security: confirmed deny change. we can approve a short exception but need justification + TTL.
mia: proposed mitigation: add a single timeboxed egress rule scoped to sg=compute-warmup -> 10.250.8.9/32:443 for 30m. will monitor and remove.
pat: created PR infra/hotfix/allow-keystore-usw2 (plan attached). snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "tmp_allow_keystore" {
  type = "egress"
  from_port = 443
  to_port = 443
  protocol = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.250.8.9/32"]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.gpu_warmup.id
  description = "TEMP allow keystore unwrap for onboarding - 30m"
}
```
devon: apply in staging -> canary 3 nodes. set ALLOC_LOG_LEVEL=debug for canary.
ops-bot: alert: warmup-failure-usw2 (20 nodes) -> now running canary
mia: canary 3/3 warmed at 6139998915. rolling to 20.
security: approved for 30m, audit note required. record owners: mia/devon/pat.
pat: will remove rule at TTL expiry and open follow-up ticket infra#5012 to implement approved egress gateway for keystore.
ops-bot: destroy infra/hotfix/allow-keystore-usw2 completed at 6139998928 by devon
mia: warm pool healthy after rollback. postmortem: root cause = overly-broad NAT deny. mitigation = timeboxed scoped allow. actions: infra#5012 egress-gateway, security to publish exception runbook, add e2e decrypt test. closing alert. :thumbsup:
